topic: National Clean Air Water and Environmental Accountability Bill

findings.title: Constitution of India, Articles 21, 48A, 51A(g), Seventh Schedule List III Item 17A, Item 20

official_sources.pinpoint: Article 21, Article 48A, Article 51A(g), Seventh Schedule List III Item 17A (Forests), Item 20 (Planning)

findings.limitations: Environmental protection is grounded in Article 21 right to life as affirmed in Subhash Kumar v. State of Bihar (1991) 1 SCC 598.

findings.title: Air (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1981; Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1974; Environment (Protection) Act, 1986
findings.limitations: Existing Acts lack quantitative individual air quality entitlements, real-time open data mandates, and strict absolute criminal corporate ecocide liability.

gaps: Absence of statutory right to clean air (<15 µg/m³ PM2.5 annual average).
Lack of mandatory real-time public sensor networks for air and water quality across every district.
Ineffective fines under legacy statutes leading to ongoing industrial toxic dumping.
